assets.prompt: The Spitter, a stray: a hollow dried Wood gourd on a short Wood staff, a Stone band round its belly and another round the shaft, and a Stone spout sticking up from its shoulder, dark inside, that it sprays from; a Stone ferrule. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eyes and brows) is a separate layer on the gourd's upper half. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours and no Blight (its spray is drawn in the enemies' Blight by the game).
